shortDescription: Module to manage QoS entries in ovirt

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: cpu_limit
options.description: The maximum processing capability in %. Used to configure computing resources.

options.name: data_center
options.description: Name of the data center where the QoS entry should be created.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the QoS.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the QoS to manage. Either C(id) or C(name) is required.

options.name: inbound_average
options.description: The desired average inbound bit rate in Mbps (Megabits per sec). Used to configure virtual machines networks. If defined, C(inbound_peak) and C(inbound_burst) also has to be set. See link:https://libvirt.org/formatnetwork.html#elementQoS[Libvirt-QOS] for further details.

options.name: inbound_burst
options.description: The amount of data that can be delivered in a single burst, in MB. Used to configure virtual machine networks. If defined, C(inbound_average) and C(inbound_peak) must also be set. See link:https://libvirt.org/formatnetwork.html#elementQoS[Libvirt-QOS] for further details.

options.name: inbound_peak
options.description: The maximum inbound rate in Mbps (Megabits per sec). Used to configure virtual machines networks. If defined, C(inbound_average) and C(inbound_burst) also has to be set. See link:https://libvirt.org/formatnetwork.html#elementQoS[Libvirt-QOS] for further details.

options.name: max_iops
options.description: The max number of read/write iops. If passed you can't pass a value for C(read_iops) or C(write_iops) If no value is given it will default to the HE value, assuming C(read_iops) or C(write_iops) hasn't been set

options.name: max_throughput
options.description: The max number of read/write throughput. If passed you can't pass a value for C(read_throughput) or C(write_throughput) If no value is given it will default to the HE value, assuming C(read_throughput) or C(write_throughput) hasn't been set

options.name: name
options.description: Name of QoS to manage. Either C(id) or C(name)/C(alias) is required.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: outbound_average
options.description: The desired average outbound bit rate in Mbps (Megabits per sec). Used to configure virtual machines networks. If defined, C(outbound_peak) and C(outbound_burst) also has to be set. See link:https://libvirt.org/formatnetwork.html#elementQoS[Libvirt-QOS] for further details.

options.name: outbound_average_linkshare
options.description: Weighted share. Used to configure host networks. Signifies how much of the logical link's capacity a specific network should be allocated, relative to the other networks attached to the same logical link. The exact share depends on the sum of shares of all networks on that link. By default this is a number in the range 1-100.

options.name: outbound_average_realtime
options.description: The committed rate in Mbps (Megabits per sec). Used to configure host networks. The minimum bandwidth required by a network. The committed rate requested is not guaranteed and will vary depending on the network infrastructure and the committed rate requested by other networks on the same logical link.

options.name: outbound_average_upperlimit
options.description: The maximum bandwidth to be used by a network in Mbps (Megabits per sec). Used to configure host networks. If C(outboundAverageUpperlimit) and C(outbound_average_realtime) are provided, the C(outbound_averageUpperlimit) must not be lower than the C(outbound_average_realtime).

options.name: outbound_burst
options.description: The amount of data that can be sent in a single burst, in MB. Used to configure virtual machine networks. If defined, C(outbound_average) and C(outbound_peak) must also be set. See link:https://libvirt.org/formatnetwork.html#elementQoS[Libvirt-QOS] for further details.

options.name: outbound_peak
options.description: The maximum outbound rate in Mbps (Megabits per sec). Used to configure virtual machines networks. If defined, C(outbound_average) and C(outbound_burst) also has to be set. See link:https://libvirt.org/formatnetwork.html#elementQoS[Libvirt-QOS] for further details.

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: read_iops
options.description: The max number of read iops. If passed you can't pass a value for C(max_iops) If no value is given it will default to the HE value, assuming C(max_iops) hasn't been set

options.name: read_throughput
options.description: The max number of read throughput. If passed you can't pass a value for C(max_throughput) If no value is given it will default to the HE value, assuming C(max_throughput) hasn't been set

options.name: state
options.description: Should the QoS be present/absent.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of QoS.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.

options.name: write_iops
options.description: The max number of write iops. If passed you can't pass a value for C(max_iops) If no value is given it will default to the HE value, assuming C(max_iops) hasn't been set

options.name: write_throughput
options.description: The max number of write throughput. If passed you can't pass a value for C(max_throughput) If no value is given it will default to the HE value, assuming C(max_throughput) hasn't been set
